title: Control Level Key
summary: Opens the door to the Control Centre Antechamber in the Steel Watch Foundry.

fields.Acquisition: Loot or pickpocket Hahns Rives in Act Three.
fields.Alternate access: The antechamber door can also be picked with a DC 30 Sleight of Hand check.

changes: Added the exact lock, carrier, and alternate access from the pinned quest walkthrough.
